author: X0X0
body:
IGN: egirl666

Punishment: Ban Evasion

Reason to unban: I’ve logged in to many alts from MCLeaks which anyone can use but have access to them only once then it expires. This is why I have many alt accounts under my IP. I was on the alt CodeNameBat in Avicus when I was banned for ban evasion. My main account egirl666 and my sister's main account Murph_the_rat was also banned so I figured it was an IP ban. I asked a mod if it was alright if I could use alts from MCLeaks and she said it was fine as long as I’m not hacking or ban evading which I wasn't. I talked to one of the Sr.Mods and he told me that my IP was registered into banned accounts like Ruffh0use. I remembered that when I logged into Avicus with that account, it was already banned so I just got another alt. There were 2 alt accounts that I’ve recently logged into that were already banned when I logged in but I was never banned while playing in any of them until CodeNameBat for ban evasion.

Hello egirl,

Due to the fact that you didn't ban evade nor hack with the Mcleaks account I will appeal your ban and Murph_the_rat's.

Please do not use McLeaks accounts as they may get you in trouble because you are linked to people you don't really know may have broken rules.

Regards,
Javi
